text:
erin: Heads-up — I'm seeing a recurring case where func-invoke returns 200 but our schema validator marks the response as REJECT (reason: unexpected_array). Canary traffic in us-west. Console shows a generic 'validation failed' card with no details. Anyone else?
maria: Yup, saw 3 alerts this morning. The dashboard rollup only shows counts, not the reject_reason breakdown. Hard to triage. :grimacing:
sam: Do we have an example payload? that'll help decide if it's validator strictness or upstream adapter change.
erin: Paste of one response (trimmed): `{"tool":"index_search","status":"ok","payload":[{"id":123,"snip":"..."}]}`. Validator expects `payload` to be an object not array. The model occasionally returns an array.
alex: Hmm, that interacts with our fncall streaming path — when streaming is on we sometimes coerce singletons into arrays. The validator currently treats array vs object as fatal.
jordan: Console UX problem: when a reject happens we only show "validation failed" and a link to the trace. Most of these traces are gated behind sampling so SRE can't see them. We need better surface-level reasons in the UI.
sam: Telemetry note: the event emitted for REJECT doesn't always include route_id or model_variant, so the console card can't link the rejection to a rollout slice. That's why ops can't see which canary is flaky.
erin: Right — also billing is confused because some of these are still charged as successful tokens (fncall returned 200) while validation marks them as rejected for tooling. We should align meter semantics.
maria: Proposal: add a short `reject_reason` string to the validation event and include a hashed sample of the offending fragment (sanitized). Display reject_reason on the card and add a "show sample (ops-only)" link that uses existing sampling ACL.
alex: Implementation concerns: storing sample blobs increases observability storage. Suggest adding a small enum for common classes (unexpected_array, missing_field, type_mismatch) as required, and optional `sample_id` pointer to S3 for a sampled subset.
jordan: UX mock: show the enum + count + clickable sample_id. Also expose a quick filter in rollouts view to show routes with >X unexpected_array rejects.
sam: On rollout policy side we need a fallback: when validator hits unexpected_array for fncall, route to a permissive variant (if available) and tag the request as "degraded". That keeps apps online.
erin: Will that hide regressions? we risk masking model bugs. Need a canary config: permissive fallback only for P0 apps or for first N% of traffic and notify via pager for higher tiers.
alex: I'll sketch the telemetry schema change: add fields `validator_code` (enum), `validator_score` (0-1), `sample_id` (optional), `is_fallbacked` (bool), `route_id`, `model_variant`. Low overhead if we keep sample_id optional.
maria: For console migration: show enum and link to rollout with a new victim-heatmap. Ops can then drill from model_variant -> reject_reason.
jordan: Quick action items: 1) alex add telemetry PR for enum + sample_id 2) sam add router change for permissive fallback + tag 3) erin add console card patch to show reject_reason and sample link 4) maria update runbook with billing note.
devx-bot: Created ticket ENGPLAT-1251 for telemetry schema change.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 02:15 UTC to test telemetry sampling (route: canary-3).
erin: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT if the canary shows new reject_reason counts.
